newsitem.title: USA: Zodiac offers to merge with NetLive.
newsitem.headline: Zodiac offers to merge with NetLive.

text.p: Zodiac Group Inc, a telephone entertainment network, said on Friday that it has offered to merge with NetLive Communications Inc.

Zodiac, which has about $7 million in annual sales from psychic telephone hotlines and other telephone entertainment, proposed to accept shares of NetLive stock in the merger and assume management of the company, Zodiac president David Felger said in a telephone interview.
"We have not received a substantive response to our proposal," Felger said.
NetLive was not immediately available for comment.
